subject.title: MissingAgentHarnessError race: non-atomic harness registry clear+restore during plugin cache cycle

question: Should empty-plugin-scope reloads preserve all previously registered agent harnesses, preserve only core or bundled provider harnesses, or intentionally clear everything and make callers wait or retry?
rationale: All three repair shapes are implementable, but the durable behavior changes plugin lifecycle and disablement semantics for third-party harnesses.

options.title: Preserve only approved harnesses
options.body: Keeps configured built-in runtimes available across empty-scope reloads while still respecting plugin disablement for third-party harnesses.

options.title: Preserve all harnesses
options.body: Matches the simpler open-PR approach but may leave third-party plugin harnesses selectable after an explicit empty active registry.

options.title: Clear and add readiness or retry
options.body: Keeps empty-scope semantics strict but requires dispatch paths to wait or retry so channel and cron messages do not fail visibly.

recommendation.title: Preserve only approved harnesses
recommendation.body: Keeps configured built-in runtimes available across empty-scope reloads while still respecting plugin disablement for third-party harnesses.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the pluggable harness registry and is the best available routing candidate for the harness ownership contract.
